startUrls.title: Pages to audit
startUrls.description: One or more http(s) page URLs. Each page is audited separately (up to 200 per run).

standards.title: axe-core rule tags
standards.description: Which rule sets to run. Default is WCAG 2.0 to 2.2 level A and AA. Other useful tags: best-practice, wcag2aaa, section508.

maxNodesPerViolation.title: Examples per violation
maxNodesPerViolation.description: How many failing elements to include for each violated rule (1 to 20).
